seo.title: Doodle Hoodie – Groomer Appointment: Overdue.
seo.description: A funny doodle hoodie for goldendoodle owners: GROOMER APPOINTMENT: OVERDUE. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

GROOMER APPOINTMENT: OVERDUE. is the doodle hoodie for the goldendoodle owner whose dog has grown out of every cut, worn on dog walks, at the park and as a gift from a family that keeps rebooking the groomer.

GROOMER stacks over APPOINTMENT: across the top and OVERDUE. fills the bottom in huge slab capitals. Between them a very shaggy goldendoodle sits proudly facing forward, curls grown so long they cover its eyes, with leaves and a twig stuck in the fur, its tongue out, and a hairbrush with a broken handle on the floor beside it.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the dog; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this doodle hoodie warm enough for dog walks and cool mornings?
Yes. The Groomer Appointment: Overdue. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for dog walks, the park and cool mornings.

How does the Groomer Appointment: Overdue. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a goldendoodle owner?
It is a natural one. Every goldendoodle owner knows the shaggy stage between cuts, so it lands with dog-park friends, dog walkers and the family that keeps rebooking the groomer. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the goldendoodle sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Groomer Appointment: Overdue. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
